name: delegate-body-trigger-inline
description: A summary-less two-level tool row (a delegate with no trailing affordance) renders its intent as a BARE direct child of .row beside the body trigger - no overlay trigger, no .intentTriggerContent wrapper. The intent must hug its text rather than grow to fill the line (which springs the body chevron to the far edge), and the body trigger must share the intent's first line: the .row[data-intent-trailing="true"] > .intent flex:0 1 auto + max-width reservation is what forces a long intent to wrap INSIDE itself instead of claiming the line and pushing the trigger to a second row. The body trigger owns its own hit target (no overlay covers it).

mutation.declaration: toolcallitem.module.css: remove the .row[data-intent-trailing="true"] > .intent max-width reservation; separately change its flex:0 1 auto to flex:1 1 0
mutation.note: Without the max-width reservation the long-intent fixtures fail sameLine (the intent claims its max-content width and the body trigger wraps). With flex-grow restored the short fixtures fail text-edge adjacency (the intent absorbs the slack and springs the body chevron to the row's far edge).
